svg.text: Candidate host biosynthesis of mutton odor-associated fatty acids
MOA · MNA · EOA | Rumen supply, epithelial handling and adipocyte ACC–FASN synthesis
ACC uses ATP + HCO₃⁻. CoA pools are compartmentalized; adipose branched donor supply is unverified.
FASN model below selects primers and donors from the precursor network; each cycle requires NADPH.

g.title: cluster_fasn
g.text: 04 CANDIDATE FASN ASSEMBLY · THREE CARBON-BALANCED ROUTES

svg.text: MITOCHONDRION: propionyl-CoA → methylmalonyl-CoA → succinyl-CoA | PCC · MCEE · MMUT / B12
CYTOSOL: ECHDC1 converts ethylmalonyl-CoA → butyryl-CoA; methylmalonyl-CoA → propionyl-CoA (lower activity).
Solid: established biochemical / physiological step | Dashed: candidate reaction | Dotted: indirect / uncertain supply
Candidate model, not demonstrated sheep flux. FASN donor acceptance and early release require validation.
